rows: An Ordinance Adopted To Provide For The Use Of Clean,
Phosphate-Free Laundry Detergents In Clermont, Georgia;
To Provide A Statement Of Policy; To Provide For
Definitions; To Limit The Amount Of Phosphorus In
Household Laundry Detergent; To Provide For Rules And
Regulations And Enforcement; To Establish A Date For
Compliance; To Provide Penalties For Violations; To
Provide For The Effective Date Hereof .
